nodes.title: Prompt
widgets_values:
A young professional woman riding alone on a modern commuter train in the
late afternoon. She is the clear main subject, seated beside the window and
framed from the thighs upward, holding a smartphone in one hand while the
other rests naturally on a canvas tote bag on her lap. She wears a navy coat,
a light blouse and simple workwear trousers. Outside the window, a soft blur
of city buildings and tracks suggests motion. In the background, a few other
passengers sit farther down the carriage, and metal poles, overhead handles,
seat textures and cool daylight reflections define the interior. Grounded
live-action urban realism, natural posture, believable facial features,
clean modern design, subtle reflections, soft ambient light and a calm daily
commute mood.
